Bring human + AI operations under control

Platforms increasingly determine how customers engage, employees work, and AI acts. Yet fragmented technology, poor configuration, and disconnected workflows can make every change slower, riskier, and more expensive.
Concentrix helps enterprises engineer, innovate, orchestrate, optimize, and operate the platform environments required for connected, controlled, and continually improving Human-AI operations.
Make your platforms work harder
Architect, modernize, configure, and connect enterprise platforms around the journeys, workflows, users, and business outcomes they need to support.

Configure how people, AI agents, copilots and automation work together across platform-enabled workflows, with the right context, decisions, handoffs and controls.
Recover more value from existing platforms by improving performance, workflows, adoption, and the operating environment around them.
Keep live platform environments reliable, governed, supported, and improving through managed services, AI oversight, and performance management.

pages.raw_meta: We’re Concentrix. A new breed of tech company — Human-centered. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled. We design, build, and run enterprise-wide experiences that touch hearts and move markets.
raw_blocks: We design, build, and run integrated human + AI operations inside the world’s most complex enterprises. Working with you from ambition to operational reality. By your side until it performs, accountable for the outcome.
Built for a new reality

The industry has spent decades separating strategy, technology, and operations. One firm to consult. Another to build. Another to run. Clients absorb the risk of making them connect. We were built to close that gap.
Trusted by organizations across every major sector, from high growth innovators to iconic global brands, Concentrix operates at the intersection of technology, intelligence, and execution.
of human + AI interactions every year
Fortune Global 500 companies trust us

Global standard for AI governance
We’ve seen it all before.
Our business has evolved through every industry supercycle. We predicted the shifts, adapted early, and helped thousands of clients turn disruption into direction.
That experience has taught us how traditional models break, where fragmented approaches fail, and why integration is now the key differentiator between AI ambition and enterprise outcomes.

We invest in the areas that matter most to our clients, working closely to understand what they need, and collaborating with them until they see the results they need. One intelligent transformation partner from strategy to delivery.
